notablePrerequisites: You have at least five creature cards in your graveyard.
description:
Cast Karador by paying {W}{B}{G}.
When Karador enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Karador.
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability twice by tapping Karador and the Karador token, adding {W}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Karador, adding {G}.
Cast Karador from your graveyard by paying {W}{B}{G}.
When Karador enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers,
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Karador token, adding {1}.
Resolve the Cadric trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Karador.
Repeat from step 3.
